visual: The black coupe drives hard along the wet waterfront boulevard, water spraying from the tires, police lights far behind.
dialogue: ALEX (V.O.): "Three hours ago, this was supposed to be a simple delivery."
sound: rain, rising engine, tire spray, distant sirens

visual: Inside the car: Alex grips the wheel, eyes flicking to the mirror, jaw tight. Empty hands on the wheel, nothing else.
The mirror: two police cars and a helicopter searchlight sweeping the wet road behind him.
The coupe slides through a wide turn and dives into an underpass, headlights stabbing through the rain.
dialogue: ALEX: "Come on, come on, come on."
sound: tire squeal, engine, echo in the underpass

visual: A cold blue glow pulses from the passenger footwell and washes over Alex's face. He glances down, then away.
A police roadblock ahead. Alex cuts hard into a dark side street; the cruisers overshoot behind him.
sound: sirens, tire squeal, impact of rain

visual: Hard cut to black. Title: THE WRONG DELIVERY. A low sting rises and stops dead.
Title super: THREE HOURS EARLIER. Caldera Bay at dusk in the rain, towers, harbour, neon switching on.
A lock-up garage. Alex, sleeves rolled, works under the hood of the black coupe. A bare bulb swings. Unpaid notices are piled on the bench.
sound: wrench on metal, rain on tin roof

visual: His phone buzzes on the bench. He wipes his hands and answers.
dialogue: MIA (PHONE): "Still need the money?" / ALEX: "Who is this?"

visual: Close on Alex's face as he listens. We hear only the voice.
dialogue: MIA (PHONE): "Someone who needs a driver. Tonight."

visual: He looks at the stack of unpaid notices, then at the coupe. He decides.
camera: insert on the notices, then pan to Alex

visual: He shrugs on the weathered black leather jacket, straightens the silver watch on his wrist.
Alex gets into the coupe. The engine catches. He looks at himself in the mirror.
dialogue: ALEX: "One job. That's all."

visual: The car rolls out of the garage into the street, headlights sweeping across the wet road and the sign of the garage.
camera: wide shot from across the street
dialogue: MIA (PHONE): "Eleven o'clock. The Meridian Club. Don't be late."

visual: The Meridian Club: curved magenta canopy, warm-gold entrance, velvet ropes. The coupe pulls up on the wet asphalt.
camera: wide establishing shot, slow push in

visual: Alex steps out and nods at the doorman.
Mia Reyes comes out under a doorman's umbrella: burgundy satin blouse, cream blazer, gold hoops. She walks straight to him.
Two-shot over Alex's shoulder, the club glowing behind Mia.
dialogue: MIA: "You're late." / ALEX: "You said eleven. It's ten fifty-eight."

visual: Mia does not smile. Alex rests an arm on the roof of the car.
dialogue: MIA: "Names don't matter tonight. Delivery does." / ALEX: "I drive. I don't deliver."

visual: Mia holds out a flat dark envelope. Alex takes it.
dialogue: MIA: "Pier Nineteen. Midnight. Do not open the package."

visual: Close on the envelope in Alex's hands. He tests its weight. Almost nothing.
dialogue: ALEX: "What's in it?" / MIA: "Instructions. Nothing else."

visual: Mia steps closer and lowers her voice, rain on her hair.
dialogue: MIA: "If anyone asks, you never met me."

visual: Alex pockets the envelope. Across the street a parked sedan, two men inside, watching. He sees them; Mia does not.
camera: slow pan from Alex to the sedan

visual: Mia walks back into the club. The doorman closes the velvet rope behind her.
dialogue: ALEX: "Easy money."

visual: Alex is back in the car. In the rain-streaked side window we see the sedan's headlights come on.
The coupe glides through a tunnel of neon and rain. Behind it, a sedan keeps the same gap.
Alex checks the mirror and takes a sudden turn. In the mirror the sedan turns too.
dialogue: ALEX: "Not a coincidence."

visual: Alex runs a late amber light between two trucks. The sedan stops at red and falls out of frame.
The coupe slows at the gates of Pier 19: stacked containers, cranes, sodium lamps, a ship at anchor.
camera: slow push in through the gate

visual: Pier 19 yard in light mist. Alex parks and steps out, the container stacks towering over him.
A foreman at a container office door reads the envelope under a lamp.
dialogue: FOREMAN: "Wrong night for visitors." / ALEX: "Pier Nineteen. Midnight."

visual: The foreman checks both ends of the yard and nods toward a stack.
dialogue: FOREMAN: "Forty-two B. Take the brown box. Nothing else."

visual: Alex walks the narrow corridor between containers, cranes looming above.
A medium brown taped box on a pallet, a crane load swinging far above. Alex lifts it. Heavier than it looks.
dialogue: ALEX: "It's heavy."

visual: Alex carries the box past his coupe and stops, turning toward distant footsteps.
dialogue: ALEX (V.O.): "I should have walked away the moment I saw that box."

visual: At the end of the corridor two silhouettes with flashlights search the stacks. Alex ducks behind a container.
A flashlight beam crosses the wet metal inches from him. He holds his breath.
He slips to the coupe and sets the box on the passenger seat. He closes the door softly.
Inside the car, doors locked, rain drumming on the roof. Alex stares at the box.
dialogue: ALEX: "Do not open the package."

visual: He slits the tape with his car key and pulls open the flaps.
Inside the box, a hard dark case. A latch clicks. Blue light leaks from under the lid.
dialogue: ALEX: "What the hell is this?"

visual: The lid rises. A blue glowing device pulses inside. Alex's face is lit blue.
His phone buzzes: MIA. He answers without taking his eyes off the glow.
dialogue: ALEX: "It's glowing, Mia." / MIA (PHONE): "Close it. Close it now."

visual: In the mirror, three sets of headlights turn in at the pier gate. Alex slams the case shut.
dialogue: MIA (PHONE): "Drive. Don't stop. Don't call anyone."

visual: The coupe launches, tires spinning on wet concrete. Container stacks blur past.
Two black SUVs and a police cruiser pour out of side roads behind him, sirens rising.
The chase down the waterfront. Alex weaves between cars, water exploding from the tires.
dialogue: ALEX (V.O.): "By then, half the city was looking for me."

visual: Close on Alex weaving; sparks scrape under the car. The engine coughs.
dialogue: ALEX: "Not now!"

visual: Alex swings the coupe into a dead-end service alley, kills the lights, and rolls to a stop in the dark.
sound: tires on wet stone, engine off

visual: Alex gets out, empty-handed but for the case, and runs out the far end of the alley. Far behind at the mouth, flashlights and police lights; the pursuers are small and distant.
He doubles back along a parallel lane, steam rising, a helicopter searchlight sweeping the rooftops.
Alex reaches the dark coupe, throws himself in, turns the key. The helicopter light finds the alley.
dialogue: ALEX: "Start. Please start."

visual: The coupe bursts out of the alley under the searchlight, spray and red taillights, and is gone.
Muted peach dawn over Caldera Bay: pale gold at the horizon, soft haze, a glass tower catching the first light.
Alex rides the mirrored elevator, the case in his hand, jaw set, rain still on his jacket.
The doors open. Mia sits behind a dark marble desk, calm, a decanter and one glass beside her.
dialogue: MIA: "You came back."

visual: Alex sets the case on the desk. Mia does not look at it.
dialogue: ALEX: "You told me it was a package." / MIA: "It was."

visual: Alex, tired and furious, leans on the desk.
dialogue: ALEX: "Men with guns chased me across the city. It glows, Mia."

visual: Mia finally lifts her eyes to him, steady.
dialogue: MIA: "They weren't after you. They were after it."

visual: Alex stares at her. The peach light crosses the desk.
dialogue: ALEX: "Then why send me?" / MIA: "You were never meant to deliver it."

visual: Alex leans over the desk. Mia slowly lifts her gaze to him.
dialogue: ALEX: "Then what was I meant to do?" / MIA: "You were meant to disappear."

visual: Close on the glowing case on the desk. The pulse quickens. Mia glances at it.
dialogue: MIA: "And now it knows your name."

visual: Alex looks at his own blue-lit hands. Through the glass, far below, a black SUV pulls up in the street.
dialogue: ALEX (V.O.): "That's when I understood the delivery was never the job."

visual: Hard cut to black. End card: THE WRONG DELIVERY, EPISODE 2 SOON.
